sampling_caveat: Control extras use frames 5,25,...485. Learned-policy extras use 25 unique evenly spaced candidates per episode from positive multiples of 5, including the first and last candidate. Early deaths prevent matching the frame stride. The comparison changes visited states and within-episode sampling density; it does not isolate those effects. Neither arm pads or repeats candidate row indices; exact input overlap with the base is retained and reported.
